einzeiler: A nostalgic look at the 2001 children's comedy film Max Keeble's Big Move.
kurzfassung: The hosts break down the 2001 family comedy Max Keeble's Big Move, discussing its nostalgic appeal and over-the-top plot elements. They analyze the film's production background, box office performance, and heavy-hitting cast of former child stars. The conversation also touches on the movie's surprisingly socialist themes and absurd middle school shenanigans.
stichpunkte: Discussion of 2001's Max Keeble's Big Move and childhood memories associated with it
Comparison of the movie's world to other pre-teen media like Recess and Big Fat Liar
Review of production numbers, including a $25 million budget and theatrical release after going over budget
Mention of the stellar cast of child stars appearing in the film, including Josh Peck and Noel Fisher
Analysis of the opening dream sequence featuring an over-the-top ice cream man
Exploration of the various school bullies and the socialist or capitalist overtones in the plot
Recapping Max's elaborate revenge plan against his bullies and the corrupt principal
Final ratings and thoughts on the film's nostalgic value and message about standing up to bullies

kapitel.titel: Box Office Numbers and Critical Reception
Breaking Down the Movie's Wild Opening
First Day of Junior High and Meeting the Bullies
The Epic Food Fight and Final Showdown

clips.hook: The surprising original plan for Max Keeble's Big Move
clips.text: The movie was originally intended to be a television release before soaring past its budget and getting pushed into theaters.

clips.hook: A remarkably gross visual gag from the film
clips.text: The hosts express genuine physical disgust at how the filmmakers portrayed a particularly nasty school dumpster.

clips.hook: The most absurdly allocated school budget pie chart
clips.text: A character discovers a hilariously skewed financial breakdown where the vast majority goes to a stadium while textbooks and salaries get scraps.

clips.hook: An unnecessarily intense and chaotic school food fight
clips.text: The cafeteria battle escalates into a full military-style operation with leaf blowers and mustard-filled instruments.

clips.hook: A great needle drop during the student uprising
clips.text: The marching band suddenly launches into a classic rock protest anthem as the entire student body confronts their bullies.
